source_name: MNB Határozatok és végzések keresése (supervisory decisions search)
why_relevant: Licensing, enforcement and market-surveillance decisions. Reveals new licences, withdrawals, outsourcing/IT-risk findings and changes of control — leading indicators of upcoming procurement or exits.

source_name: MNB Aranykönyv (Golden Book — institution-level supervisory data)
why_relevant: Per-institution balance-sheet and business-line data for credit institutions, payment institutions, financial enterprises, investment firms and insurers — the sizing layer for prioritising which registered actors are worth tracking for tenders.

source_name: EBA Central Register of Payment and E-Money Institutions (PSD2)
why_relevant: EU-wide register fed daily by MNB; includes agents and passporting. Machine-readable full download makes it the cheapest way to keep the Hungarian PSP/agent universe current, and it exposes cross-border entrants MNB pages list less clearly.

source_name: e-Cégjegyzék (official Hungarian company register, free query)
why_relevant: State company register run by the Ministry of Justice Céginformációs Szolgálat. Resolves any bank/PSP/agent/vendor to legal name, cégjegyzékszám, tax number, seat, status — the join key across all other cells' evidence.

source_name: Céginformációs Szolgálat (Ministry of Justice company information service)
why_relevant: Governing body for company register, e-beszámoló and company gazette; also sells bulk beszámoló datasets ('beszámoló állomány értékesítése') — the legal route to bulk financial-statement acquisition.

source_name: Cégközlöny online (Companies Gazette)
why_relevant: Official gazette of court company-registry decisions and direct company announcements — captures incorporations, mergers, capital changes, liquidations and scope-of-activity changes of banking/payments actors before they appear anywhere else.

source_name: OPTEN Kft. — commercial company information & monitoring
why_relevant: Deepest commercial HU company database (active + defunct entities back to 1989, weekly updates, effective/deletion dates, sub-row codes). Offers partner monitoring (partnerfigyelő) and tender advisory — a paid but high-value backbone for continuous actor tracking.

source_name: NAV adóalany adatbázis-lekérdezések (VAT/tax status databases)
why_relevant: Free official validation of adószám / VAT-subject status, including group (batch file) queries. Used to confirm that a registered bank/PSP/agent/vendor entity is live and correctly identified before attributing contracts to it.

source_name: NAV Köztartozásmentes Adózói Adatbázis (KOMA)
why_relevant: Public list of taxpayers free of public debt — a standard eligibility condition in Hungarian public procurement, so presence/absence is a qualification signal for bidders on public banking/payments tenders.

source_name: kozadat.hu — Közadatkereső (central public-data / üvegzseb search)
why_relevant: Central searchable index of Hungarian public bodies' mandatory disclosures, including the 'üvegzseb' contracts of net HUF 5m+ that must be published within 60 days. Captures public-sector banking/payments contracts that never appear as formal tender notices.

source_name: MNB pénzforgalmi intézmény licensing guidance (engedélyezési útmutatók)
why_relevant: Defines the taxonomy of licence types and activity scopes used across every MNB register — needed to interpret register fields correctly and to build the local-language glossary for downstream cells.

source_name: e-Justice EU Business Registers — Hungary (BRIS gateway)
why_relevant: EU-level gateway describing and linking the Hungarian company register; useful for cross-border resolution of foreign parents of HU banking/payments vendors and for confirming the authoritative register endpoints.

source_name: kozadat.hu — Központi Információs Közadat-nyilvántartás (KIK) public search
source_subtype: government contract register / open data search portal
why_relevant: Statutory central register (Infotv. + 499/2022. (XII. 8.) Korm. rendelet) into which budgetary bodies, municipalities and minority self-governments must report contracts, subsidies and payments at or above HUF 5 million. This is the single most complete national aggregation of 'szerződések 5 M Ft felett' and therefore captures bank account-management, cash-handling, card-acceptance, POS, payment-processing and IT contracts awarded by public bodies, including many that never appeared as a formal procurement notice.

source_name: kif.gov.hu — Közadat / KIK data-supply portal (NISZ)
why_relevant: Operator-side portal for the Central Information Public Data Registry; documents which organisations are in scope, the reporting data model and the submission schedule. Useful for judging completeness and lag of kozadat.hu records before treating them as evidence of a bank/payments deal.

source_name: 499/2022. (XII. 8.) Korm. rendelet — detailed rules of the Central Information Public Data Registry (Nemzeti Jogszabálytár)
why_relevant: Defines exactly which contract fields must be published, by whom, and with what exemptions (defence, classified, and — contested — bank secrecy). Essential to interpret gaps in the registry rather than mistaking them for absence of deals.

source_name: Government Transparency Institute (GTI) — procurement datasets and methodology
why_relevant: Hungarian research institute that maintains Opentender and publishes the indicator methodology plus derived datasets and papers on Hungarian procurement concentration. Points to further datasets and to academic contacts who hold cleaned HU contract data.

source_name: K-Monitor main site — projects and activities index
why_relevant: Enumerates K-Monitor's data products (Adatbázis, Háló/aHáló network database, RedFlags, work on the Közadat register) and its analyses of the quality of the new state contract database — a shortcut to the whole Hungarian contract-transparency toolchain.

source_name: aHáló / Háló — K-Monitor network database of elite, companies, procurements and subsidies
why_relevant: Maps ownership and personal links between Hungarian companies, politicians and public bodies and links them to public procurements and subsidies. Lets you resolve who actually stands behind a winning bidder in a banking-IT or payment-services contract, which raw award notices never reveal.

source_name: KiMitTud (atlatszo.hu) — Hungarian FOI request archive (Alaveteli)
why_relevant: Public archive of freedom-of-information requests and the authorities' answers, operated by Átlátszó. Requests titled 'Szerződések adatai' routinely extract contract lists that bodies never published proactively — including refusals, which themselves reveal that a contract exists. Also usable as an active collection channel: you can file your own request.

source_name: DKÜ Zrt. — centralised government IT procurement register and public-interest data
source_subtype: state agency / centralised IT procurement system
why_relevant: Under 301/2018. (XII. 27.) Korm. rendelet, in-scope state bodies may only procure IT through the Digital Government Agency. Its public-interest-data page (including its own 5 M Ft contract list) plus its procurement system reveal the pipeline for payment/banking IT, terminals and licences in the state sector before awards surface elsewhere.

source_name: NAIH — általános közzétételi lista / 3.4 'Öt millió forint feletti szerződések' model page
why_relevant: The data-protection and FOI authority's own disclosure page shows the canonical structure and heading path ('III. Gazdálkodási adatok' → '3.4') that virtually every Hungarian public body reuses. That fixed path is the key to writing a generic crawler that finds any body's 5 M Ft contract list, including those of banks' public-sector clients. NAIH is also the appeal body when disclosure is refused.

source_name: Magyar Államkincstár — közérdekű adatok, III.4 contracts above five million HUF
why_relevant: The Treasury is both a major payments actor (institutional account-keeping, and from Oct 2025 the mandated account keeper for municipalities, displacing commercial banks such as OTP) and a large buyer of payment/IT services. Its own contract list is a high-value direct source for this cell and a way to date the shift in municipal account-management business.

source_name: kozadattar.hu — third-party public-data aggregation site
why_relevant: Surfaced alongside kozadat.hu as a Hungarian public-data aggregation site; potentially a secondary index of közérdekű adat disclosures. Listed as a lead to be assessed — its operator, scope and freshness were not established in this pass.
